decisions.reason: The VMID-to-VSYS topology clarification does not change the USB-C connector or its sourceability requirements.
The clarification concerns an internal AXP2101 VMID-to-VSYS connection and does not alter the battery connector, pinout, placement, or mounting requirements.
Connecting VMID and VSYS as shown in the reference does not change the required battery NTC sensing method.
Although this Requirement also uses the AXP2101, the source only resolves VMID-to-VSYS topology and does not change the established battery-protection modes or cutoff values.
The electrical topology clarification does not entail any change to board dimensions, orientation, connector placement, mounting holes, or enclosure fit.
The AXP2101 VMID-to-VSYS connection does not modify the separate switched 5V boost converter, its enable control, or its powered loads.
The topology clarification does not change how battery-charge status is indicated or the GPIO and LED chain used for that indication.
Permitting the referenced VMID-to-VSYS connection does not alter the selected eight-layer board stack.
The source decision does not change the separate requirement for TVS-based ESD protection.
The internal AXP2101 VMID-to-VSYS topology does not change the interboard connector architecture, signals, or physical pin-order policy.

The source does not change the deferred BOM part-number and component-role documentation obligations; any eventual schematic-file update is not established as a modification of this production-package state.
The VMID-to-VSYS clarification is unrelated to the I2C bus speed, pull-ups, cable length, or retained series resistors.
